tldr_zh: OpenAI發布企業AI代理案例，Google推出手語AI模型，Anthropic的Claude新增浮水印功能引發爭議。
tldr_en: OpenAI releases enterprise AI agent insights, Google debuts sign language AI, Anthropic's Claude watermarking sparks user backlash.

items.title_zh: OpenAI發布企業採用AI代理成果報告
items.title_en: OpenAI Reveals How Enterprises Adopt Agentic AI Solutions
items.summary_zh: OpenAI發布研究成果，展示企業如何採用代理式AI技術，利用ChatGPT與Codex加速業務轉型。報告揭示業界領先企業在AI採用速度與應用方面的優勢，為其他組織提供實踐參考。
items.summary_en: OpenAI releases research showing how enterprises adopt agentic AI using ChatGPT and Codex, revealing how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption and transformation.

items.title_zh: Google DeepMind推出手語轉文字AI突破性模型
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Introduces Sign Language-to-Text AI Model
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出SL2T模型，能將手語即時轉換為文字，為聾人和聽障用戶提供重要的無障礙溝通工具。該技術將整合到Google產品中，預計大幅改善這群用戶的使用體驗。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind launches sign-language-to-text (SL2T) model, a breakthrough enabling real-time conversion of sign language to text for Deaf and hard of hearing users, with integration into Google products.

items.title_zh: Anthropic的Claude新增浮水印功能引發用戶不滿
items.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Watermarking Feature Sparks User Controversy
items.summary_zh: Anthropic在Claude中新增浮水印技術，可識別AI生成的內容，但此舉遭到用戶批評，擔心被雇主或學校發現在工作和課程中使用AI。該功能引發關於隱私與監控的倫理爭議。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's new watermarking system for Claude sparks backlash from users concerned about detection in workplace and academic settings, raising privacy and surveillance concerns.

items.title_zh: Google正式發布Pixel 11系列手機，起價899美元
items.title_en: Google Announces Pixel 11 Series with New Tensor G6 Chip
items.summary_zh: Google發布Pixel 11、Pixel 11 Pro、Pixel 11 Pro XL和Pixel 11 Pro Fold等新機，搭載Tensor G6晶片與升級相機。預購用戶可獲最高350美元的禮卡優惠，起價899美元。
items.summary_en: Google unveils Pixel 11 lineup starting at $899, featuring upgraded Tensor G6 chip and improved cameras, with preorder incentives up to $350 in gift cards.

items.title_en: Apple's Base iPhone 18 Launch Delayed to Q1 2027
items.summary_zh: 根據供應商Pegatron的財報確認，基礎版iPhone 18將延至2027年Q1推出，而Pro系列仍在秋季發布。此舉為蘋果近年罕見的差異化發布策略。
items.summary_en: Pegatron confirms base iPhone 18 delayed to Q1 2027, while iPhone 18 Pro launches in fall, marking an unusual staggered release strategy for Apple.

items.title_zh: Amazon將預設使用Twitch創作者內容訓練AI模型
items.title_en: Amazon Defaults to Using Twitch Content for AI Training Without Opt-In
items.summary_zh: Amazon宣布將預設使用Twitch創作者的串流內容、VOD、聊天記錄等訓練AI模型，創作者可主動選擇退出。Twitch高管坦言若採用同意制，無人願意參與此計畫。
items.summary_en: Amazon will train AI models on Twitch content by default unless creators opt out. Twitch CPO admits opt-in approach would yield zero participation.

items.title_zh: 新型ShieldFont字體可有效毒化AI訓練數據
items.title_en: New Font Technology Poisons AI Training Data Without Affecting Human Readability
items.summary_zh: 資安研究推出ShieldFont技術，透過特殊字體設計在網頁對AI爬蟲產生干擾，使其學到錯誤數據，但對人類閱讀無影響。這是對抗非法AI數據爬取的新武器。
items.summary_en: ShieldFont technology uses specially designed fonts to poison AI training data while remaining readable to humans, offering new defense against unauthorized AI scraping.

items.title_zh: AI編程新創Cognition估值躍升至400億美元融資談判
items.title_en: AI Coding Startup Cognition Eyes $40B Valuation in New Funding Round
items.summary_zh: AI程式碼生成新創Cognition在數月前以260億美元估值融資10億美元後，現已在400億美元估值融資談判中。該公司展現強勁的市場需求與投資者信心。
items.summary_en: Cognition, an AI coding startup, is in talks to raise at $40B valuation just months after raising $1B at $26B, signaling strong investor confidence in AI development tools.

items.title_zh: 台灣大砸291億元公開收購精誠深化AI與企業服務整合
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile Announces NT$29.1B Tender Offer for Systex to Boost AI Services
items.summary_zh: 台灣大透過全資子公司公開收購精誠，目標增持至少39%股權，若達上限將持股58%成為控制股東。此舉旨在整合精誠IT與台灣大電信能力，透過AI與跨售創造綜效。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Mobile announces NT$29.1B tender offer for Systex targeting 39%+ stake to integrate IT services and telecom capabilities for AI-driven enterprise solutions.

items.title_zh: AI工具協助不到24小時找出Zoom零點擊漏洞
items.title_en: Researchers Use AI to Discover Zoom Zero-Click Vulnerability in Under 24 Hours
items.summary_zh: 資安研究團隊使用公開AI模型協助分析，不到24小時發現Zoom註解功能的三項重大漏洞，可遠端執行程式碼控制裝置。此案例展示AI在資安研究的威力與風險。
items.summary_en: Security researchers using publicly available AI models discovered critical Zoom zero-click vulnerabilities in under 24 hours, enabling remote code execution and device control.

items.title_zh: 供應鏈攻擊導致數TB憑證洩露，2500名AI套件用戶受影響
items.title_en: Massive Supply-Chain Attack Leaks Terabytes of Credentials from 2,500 Users
items.summary_zh: 駭客透過入侵AI套件的供應鏈，從2500名使用者竊取數TB級別的認證資料。此事件凸顯企業對第三方套件依賴的資安風險。
items.summary_en: Attackers compromise AI package supply chain, exfiltrating terabytes of credentials from 2,500 users, highlighting third-party software security risks.

items.title_zh: 烏克蘭攻擊俄國黑海港口穀物設施，全球糧食供應面臨威脅
items.title_en: Ukraine Strikes Russian Black Sea Grain Terminals, Threatening Global Food Supply
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭對俄國黑海港市諾沃羅西斯克發動大規模無人機攻擊，導致重要穀物出口設施停運。俄烏雙方互相攻擊對方運輸設施，全球糧食出口受到影響。
items.summary_en: Ukraine launches major drone attacks on Russian Black Sea port, disrupting grain export terminals as both nations target each other's shipping facilities, impacting global grain supplies.

items.title_zh: 挪威主權基金上半年投報創850億美元新高，台積電等科技股助力
items.title_en: Norway's Sovereign Fund Posts Record $185B Return for First Half of 2026
items.summary_zh: 挪威主權財富基金上半年投資報酬達850億美元（約5.96兆台幣）創紀錄新高，成功從年初虧損中反彈。台積電等科技股表現優異，有力支撐基金收益。
items.summary_en: Norway's sovereign wealth fund achieves record $185B return in first half of 2026, rebounding from early losses with strong performance from TSMC and tech stocks.
